text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Eishin 
Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nakayama-san. Are you going to train 
now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess... But I really can't get 
into the mood for it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Could it be that you're not 
feeling well?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It ain't like that. Practice just ain't 
got enough thrills, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...A thrill, is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about trying a tandem run with 
someone?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A tandem run, huh? Sounds great! We 
should get a nice, heated contest out of 
it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, you're coming with me since 
you're the one who brought it up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Me? Indeed, that sounds like a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Would it be alright if I went 
with Nakayama-san?
choice_data_list: I really need to get some rest today

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You asked for a fiery thrill, did you not? 
I shall run with all my might to live up 
to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, haha...! Now that's what I'm 
talkin' about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them threw themselves 
into their tandem training.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Overdoing our training 
isn't good, after all.
choice_data_list:
Let's do a practice run together another 
day!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, that sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but I'll make time to join 
you another day, so could you let me know 
when you're free?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"So ya ain't plannin' on leavin' it as 
just a verbal promise, huh... Sheesh, 
you're one dutiful young lady."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After promising to train side-by-side, 
Eishin Flash headed straight back to the 
dorms for the day.
